facts.text: Serve the mains when Michael tries to do the Kansas City accent.
facts.why: Michael has to play a gangster called Kansas City Little Big Mickey Blue Eyes, but the sources do not describe a Kansas City accent scene.
facts.fix: Serve the mains when Michael starts playing Mickey Blue Eyes.

facts.why: Vito Graziosi is the mob boss in the film. Sources give no restaurant called Vito's and describe Gina's dad as the restaurateur.
No source describes a Madonn' lesson or a numbered pronunciation card in the film.

facts.text: Still life with clams. Oil on canvas, lots of oil. All for sale. Do not laugh.
facts.why: Michael works at an auction house, but no source mentions Johnny painting a clam still life.
facts.fix: Lot 1, a very bad painting. All for sale.

vibe.verdict: Handsome Little Italy menu with decent food, but the details lean on guesses and the film's own jokes are thin.
